senses.sense_definition: The serous membrane that lines the abdominal cavity and covers the internal organs in mammals.

examples.text: The surgeon carefully examined the <w>peritoneum</w> for any signs of inflammation or infection.
Fluid can sometimes accumulate within the <w>peritoneum</w> due to various medical conditions.

senses.sense_definition: The membrane that lines the coelom cavity in animals.

examples.text: In many invertebrates, the <w>peritoneum</w> serves as a protective lining for the body cavity.
The development of the <w>peritoneum</w> is a key feature in the evolution of complex animal body plans.
